personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply elegant spiritual space blending glowing antique gold typography with dark emerald glass and beautiful architecture.

spacing.rule: Generous, cinematic padding. Cards should never touch screen edges. Use empty space intentionally to give the calligraphy room to breathe.

do's: Use heavy glass blur for the bottom tab bar and header over scrolling content.
Apply frosted glass (with #182118 base tint at 75% opacity) for the Next Prayer hero card overlaying the background image.
Ensure text on glass uses onSurface and has perfect contrast.
dont's: Do not blur standard list rows in the Adhkar tab; use surfaceSecondary instead.
Do not blur form inputs or switches.

screens.name: الرئيسية (Home)
screens.purpose: Displays the majestic next prayer countdown hero and the daily 5 prayer times list.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner in Antique Gold.
states.empty: No prayer data (show location permission prompt).
states.error: Failed to fetch GPS/Prayer times. Show retry button.

screens.layout: Top half is a full-bleed hero image of the Sheikh Zayed mosque at night, covered with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Placed centrally in the hero is a large frosted glass card showing the Next Prayer name and large countdown timer in Amiri font. Below the hero is a vertical list of the 5 prayers in surfaceSecondary cards. The active/next prayer card is highlighted with a brandPrimary (Gold) border and glow.

screens.name: الأذكار (Adhkar)
screens.purpose: List of rotating dhikr reminders where users can toggle active ones and listen to the audio.
screens.layout: A cinematic header featuring a dark Islamic pattern background. The body contains a list of cards, each holding a beautiful Arabic dhikr (e.g., 'صلِّ على محمد') in large Amiri text. Each card has a Play icon button (to preview the AI voice) and a standard native Switch to enable/disable it in the rotation.

screens.name: الإعدادات (Settings)
screens.purpose: Configuration for audio, intervals, and location.
screens.layout: Minimalist list of settings. Master switch at the top. Segmented control (or selectable chips) for interval selection (15, 30, 60 mins). A button to refresh location for accurate Adhan. UI should be right-to-left (RTL) natively.

hero_mosque.alt: Beautiful Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque at night, illuminated over water

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Amiri' and 'Tajawal' using @expo-google-fonts or expo-font with downloaded TTF if required. Apply 'Amiri' strictly for display typography (prayer names, dhikr text, timer), and 'Tajawal' for standard UI labels.
Implement RTL layout. Use 'flexDirection: row-reverse' or I18nManager.forceRTL(true) globally. Make sure icons point the correct way.

For the Home tab's hero section, implement a gradient scrim (expo-linear-gradient) over the background image (transparent at top, #0D110D at bottom) to ensure the prayer times list scrolling up perfectly blends with the hero image.
Use expo-blur heavily but correctly. The 'Next Prayer' card on the Home screen should be frosted glass (tint #182118, opacity 75%) hovering over the mosque image.
Audio TTS for Dhikr reminders should be wired in the Adhkar list (play button).
Interval selector should use a high-contrast elegant segmented control or prominent choice chips.
Colors: Strictly adhere to the Dark Espresso/Emerald/Gold palette. No blue or purple allowed.
